verses.original: וְהָיָ֗ה אִם־ שָׁמ֤וֹעַ תִּשְׁמַע֙ בְּקוֹל֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ לִשְׁמֹ֤ר לַעֲשׂוֹת֙ אֶת־ כָּל־ מִצְוֺתָ֔יו אֲשֶׁ֛ר אָנֹכִ֥י מְצַוְּךָ֖ הַיּ֑וֹם וּנְתָ֨נְךָ֜ יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֙יךָ֙ עֶלְי֔וֹן עַ֖ל כָּל־ גּוֹיֵ֥י הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh ’im- šā·mō·w·a‘ tiš·ma‘ bə·qō·wl Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā liš·mōr la·‘ă·śō·wṯ ’eṯ- kāl- miṣ·wō·ṯāw ’ă·šer ’ā·nō·ḵî mə·ṣaw·wə·ḵā hay·yō·wm ū·nə·ṯā·nə·ḵā Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā ‘el·yō·wn ‘al kāl- gō·w·yê hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: Now if you faithfully obey . . . the voice of the LORD your God and are careful to follow all His commandments I am giving you today . . . the LORD your God . . . will set you high above all the nations of the earth
verses.literalPt: E SERÁ que, se ouvires a voz do SENHOR teu Deus, tendo cuidado de guardar todos os seus mandamentos que eu hoje te ordeno, o SENHOR teu Deus te exaltará sobre todas as nações da terra.

verses.original: וּבָ֧אוּ עָלֶ֛יךָ כָּל־ הַבְּרָכ֥וֹת הָאֵ֖לֶּה וְהִשִּׂיגֻ֑ךָ כִּ֣י תִשְׁמַ֔ע בְּק֖וֹל יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇā·’ū ‘ā·le·ḵā kāl- hab·bə·rā·ḵō·wṯ hā·’êl·leh wə·hiś·śî·ḡu·ḵā kî ṯiš·ma‘ bə·qō·wl Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā
verses.literal: And all these blessings will come upon you and overtake you if you will obey the voice of the LORD your God
verses.literalPt: E todas estas bênçãos virão sobre ti e te alcançarão, quando ouvires a voz do SENHOR teu Deus;

verses.original: בָּר֥וּךְ אַתָּ֖ה בָּעִ֑יר וּבָר֥וּךְ אַתָּ֖ה בַּשָּׂדֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: bā·rūḵ ’at·tāh bā·‘îr ū·ḇā·rūḵ ’at·tāh baś·śā·ḏeh
verses.literal: You will be blessed in the city and blessed . . . in the country
verses.literalPt: Bendito serás na cidade, e bendito serás no campo.

verses.original: בָּר֧וּךְ פְּרִֽי־ בִטְנְךָ֛ וּפְרִ֥י אַדְמָתְךָ֖ וּפְרִ֣י בְהֶמְתֶּ֑ךָ שְׁגַ֥ר אֲלָפֶ֖יךָ וְעַשְׁתְּר֥וֹת צֹאנֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: bā·rūḵ pə·rî- ḇiṭ·nə·ḵā ū·p̄ə·rî ’aḏ·mā·ṯə·ḵā ū·p̄ə·rî ḇə·hem·te·ḵā šə·ḡar ’ă·lā·p̄e·ḵā wə·‘aš·tə·rō·wṯ ṣō·ne·ḵā
verses.literal: The fruit of your womb will be blessed as well as the produce of your land and the offspring of your livestock the calves of your herds and the lambs of your flocks
verses.literalPt: Bendito o fruto do teu ventre, e o fruto da tua terra, e o fruto dos teus animais; e as crias das tuas vacas e das tuas ovelhas.

verses.original: בָּר֥וּךְ טַנְאֲךָ֖ וּמִשְׁאַרְתֶּֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: bā·rūḵ ṭan·’ă·ḵā ū·miš·’ar·te·ḵā
verses.literal: Your basket and kneading bowl will be blessed
verses.literalPt: Bendito o teu cesto e a tua amassadeira.

verses.original: בָּר֥וּךְ אַתָּ֖ה בְּבֹאֶ֑ךָ וּבָר֥וּךְ אַתָּ֖ה בְּצֵאתֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: bā·rūḵ ’at·tāh bə·ḇō·’e·ḵā ū·ḇā·rūḵ ’at·tāh bə·ṣê·ṯe·ḵā
verses.literal: You will be blessed when you come in and blessed when you go out
verses.literalPt: Bendito serás ao entrares, e bendito serás ao saíres.

verses.original: יִתֵּ֨ן יְהוָ֤ה אֶת־ אֹיְבֶ֙יךָ֙ הַקָּמִ֣ים עָלֶ֔יךָ נִגָּפִ֖ים לְפָנֶ֑יךָ בְּדֶ֤רֶךְ אֶחָד֙ יֵצְא֣וּ אֵלֶ֔יךָ וּבְשִׁבְעָ֥ה דְרָכִ֖ים יָנ֥וּסוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: yit·tên Yah·weh ’eṯ- ’ō·yə·ḇe·ḵā haq·qā·mîm ‘ā·le·ḵā nig·gā·p̄îm lə·p̄ā·ne·ḵā bə·ḏe·reḵ ’e·ḥāḏ yê·ṣə·’ū ’ê·le·ḵā ū·ḇə·šiḇ·‘āh ḏə·rā·ḵîm yā·nū·sū lə·p̄ā·ne·ḵā
verses.literal: The LORD will cause the enemies who rise up against you to be defeated before you They will march out against you in one direction but flee from you in seven
verses.literalPt: O SENHOR entregará, feridos diante de ti, os teus inimigos, que se levantarem contra ti; por um caminho sairão contra ti, mas por sete caminhos fugirão da tua presença.

verses.original: יְצַ֨ו יְהוָ֤ה אִתְּךָ֙ אֶת־ הַבְּרָכָ֔ה בַּאֲסָמֶ֕יךָ וּבְכֹ֖ל מִשְׁלַ֣ח יָדֶ֑ךָ וּבֵ֣רַכְךָ֔ בָּאָ֕רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ נֹתֵ֥ן לָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: yə·ṣaw Yah·weh ’it·tə·ḵā ’eṯ- hab·bə·rā·ḵāh ba·’ă·sā·me·ḵā ū·ḇə·ḵōl miš·laḥ yā·ḏe·ḵā ū·ḇê·raḵ·ḵā bā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā nō·ṯên lāḵ
verses.literal: The LORD - will decree a blessing on your barns and on everything to which you put your hand the LORD your God will bless you in the land He is giving you
verses.literalPt: O SENHOR mandará que a bênção esteja contigo nos teus celeiros, e em tudo o que puseres a tua mão; e te abençoará na terra que te der o SENHOR teu Deus.

verses.original: יְקִֽימְךָ֨ יְהוָ֥ה לוֹ֙ לְעַ֣ם קָד֔וֹשׁ כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר נִֽשְׁבַּֽע־ לָ֑ךְ כִּ֣י תִשְׁמֹ֗ר אֶת־ מִצְוֺת֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ וְהָלַכְתָּ֖ בִּדְרָכָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: yə·qî·mə·ḵā Yah·weh lōw lə·‘am qā·ḏō·wōš ka·’ă·šer niš·ba‘- lāḵ kî ṯiš·mōr ’eṯ- miṣ·wōṯ Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā wə·hā·laḵ·tā biḏ·rā·ḵāw
verses.literal: The LORD will establish you as His holy people just as He has sworn to you if you keep the commandments of the LORD your God and walk in His ways
verses.literalPt: O SENHOR te confirmará para si como povo santo, como te tem jurado, quando guardares os mandamentos do SENHOR teu Deus, e andares nos seus caminhos.

verses.original: וְרָאוּ֙ כָּל־ עַמֵּ֣י הָאָ֔רֶץ כִּ֛י שֵׁ֥ם יְהוָ֖ה נִקְרָ֣א עָלֶ֑יךָ וְיָֽרְא֖וּ מִמֶּֽךָּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·rā·’ū kāl- ‘am·mê hā·’ā·reṣ kî šêm Yah·weh niq·rā ‘ā·le·ḵā wə·yā·rə·’ū mim·me·kā
verses.literal: Then all the peoples of the earth will see that you are called by the name of the LORD and they will stand in awe of you
verses.literalPt: E todos os povos da terra verão que é invocado sobre ti o nome do SENHOR, e terão temor de ti.

verses.original: וְהוֹתִֽרְךָ֤ יְהוָה֙ לְטוֹבָ֔ה בִּפְרִ֧י בִטְנְךָ֛ וּבִפְרִ֥י בְהַמְתְּךָ֖ וּבִפְרִ֣י אַדְמָתֶ֑ךָ עַ֚ל הָאֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר נִשְׁבַּ֧ע יְהוָ֛ה לַאֲבֹתֶ֖יךָ לָ֥תֶת לָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hō·w·ṯir·ḵā Yah·weh lə·ṭō·w·ḇāh bip̄·rî ḇiṭ·nə·ḵā ū·ḇip̄·rî ḇə·ham·tə·ḵā ū·ḇip̄·rî ’aḏ·mā·ṯe·ḵā ‘al hā·’ă·ḏā·māh ’ă·šer niš·ba‘ Yah·weh la·’ă·ḇō·ṯe·ḵā lā·ṯeṯ lāḵ
verses.literal: The LORD will make you prosper abundantly in the fruit of your womb the offspring of your livestock and the produce of your land in the land that the LORD swore to your fathers to give you
verses.literalPt: E o SENHOR te dará abundância de bens no fruto do teu ventre, e no fruto dos teus animais, e no fruto do teu solo, sobre a terra que o SENHOR jurou a teus pais te dar.

verses.original: יִפְתַּ֣ח יְהוָ֣ה׀ לְ֠ךָ אֶת־ אוֹצָר֨וֹ הַטּ֜וֹב אֶת־ הַשָּׁמַ֗יִם לָתֵ֤ת מְטַֽר־ אַרְצְךָ֙ בְּעִתּ֔וֹ וּלְבָרֵ֕ךְ אֵ֖ת כָּל־ מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה יָדֶ֑ךָ וְהִלְוִ֙יתָ֙ גּוֹיִ֣ם רַבִּ֔ים וְאַתָּ֖ה לֹ֥א תִלְוֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: yip̄·taḥ Yah·weh lə·ḵā ’eṯ- ’ō·w·ṣā·rōw haṭ·ṭō·wḇ ’eṯ- haš·šā·ma·yim lā·ṯêṯ mə·ṭar- ’ar·ṣə·ḵā bə·‘it·tōw ū·lə·ḇā·rêḵ ’êṯ kāl- ma·‘ă·śêh yā·ḏe·ḵā wə·hil·wî·ṯā gō·w·yim rab·bîm wə·’at·tāh lō ṯil·weh
verses.literal: The LORD will open the heavens His abundant storehouse to send rain on your land in season and to bless all the work of your hands You will lend to many nations but borrow from none
verses.literalPt: O SENHOR te abrirá o seu bom tesouro, o céu, para dar chuva à tua terra no seu tempo, e para abençoar toda a obra das tuas mãos; e emprestarás a muitas nações, porém tu não tomarás emprestado.

verses.original: וּנְתָֽנְךָ֨ יְהוָ֤ה לְרֹאשׁ֙ וְלֹ֣א לְזָנָ֔ב וְהָיִ֙יתָ֙ רַ֣ק לְמַ֔עְלָה וְלֹ֥א תִהְיֶ֖ה לְמָ֑טָּה כִּֽי־ תִשְׁמַ֞ע אֶל־ מִצְוֺ֣ת׀ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֗יךָ אֲשֶׁ֨ר אָנֹכִ֧י מְצַוְּךָ֛ הַיּ֖וֹם לִשְׁמֹ֥ר וְלַעֲשֽׂוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: ū·nə·ṯā·nə·ḵā Yah·weh lə·rōš wə·lō lə·zā·nāḇ wə·hā·yî·ṯā raq lə·ma‘·lāh wə·lō ṯih·yeh lə·māṭ·ṭāh kî- ṯiš·ma‘ ’el- miṣ·wōṯ Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā ’ă·šer ’ā·nō·ḵî mə·ṣaw·wə·ḵā hay·yō·wm liš·mōr wə·la·‘ă·śō·wṯ
verses.literal: The LORD will make you the head and not the tail . . . you will only move upward and never . . . downward if you hear and carefully follow the commandments of the LORD your God which I am giving you today
verses.literalPt: E o SENHOR te porá por cabeça, e não por cauda; e só estarás em cima, e não debaixo, se obedeceres aos mandamentos do SENHOR teu Deus, que hoje te ordeno, para os guardar e cumprir.

verses.original: וְלֹ֣א תָס֗וּר מִכָּל־ הַדְּבָרִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֨ר אָנֹכִ֜י מְצַוֶּ֥ה אֶתְכֶ֛ם הַיּ֖וֹם יָמִ֣ין וּשְׂמֹ֑אול לָלֶ֗כֶת אַחֲרֵ֛י אֱלֹהִ֥ים אֲחֵרִ֖ים לְעָבְדָֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·lō ṯā·sūr mik·kāl had·də·ḇā·rîm ’ă·šer ’ā·nō·ḵî mə·ṣaw·weh ’eṯ·ḵem hay·yō·wm yā·mîn ū·śə·mō·wl lā·le·ḵeṯ ’a·ḥă·rê ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’ă·ḥê·rîm lə·‘ā·ḇə·ḏām
verses.literal: Do not turn aside to the right or to the left from any of the words I command you today and do not go after other gods to serve them
verses.literalPt: E não te desviarás de todas as palavras que hoje te ordeno, nem para a direita nem para a esquerda, andando após outros deuses, para os servires.

verses.original: וְהָיָ֗ה אִם־ לֹ֤א תִשְׁמַע֙ בְּקוֹל֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ לִשְׁמֹ֤ר לַעֲשׂוֹת֙ אֶת־ כָּל־ מִצְוֺתָ֣יו וְחֻקֹּתָ֔יו אֲשֶׁ֛ר אָנֹכִ֥י מְצַוְּךָ֖ הַיּ֑וֹם וּבָ֧אוּ עָלֶ֛יךָ כָּל־ הַקְּלָל֥וֹת הָאֵ֖לֶּה וְהִשִּׂיגֽוּךָ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh ’im- lō ṯiš·ma‘ bə·qō·wl Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā liš·mōr la·‘ă·śō·wṯ ’eṯ- kāl- miṣ·wō·ṯāw wə·ḥuq·qō·ṯāw ’ă·šer ’ā·nō·ḵî mə·ṣaw·wə·ḵā hay·yō·wm ū·ḇā·’ū ‘ā·le·ḵā kāl- haq·qə·lā·lō·wṯ hā·’êl·leh wə·hiś·śî·ḡū·ḵā
verses.literal: If, however you do not obey . . . the LORD your God by carefully following all His commandments and statutes I am giving you today . . . all these curses will come upon you and overtake you
verses.literalPt: Será, porém, que, se não deres ouvidos à voz do SENHOR teu Deus, para não cuidares em cumprir todos os seus mandamentos e os seus estatutos, que hoje te ordeno, então virão sobre ti todas estas maldições, e te alcançarão:

verses.original: אָר֥וּר אַתָּ֖ה בָּעִ֑יר וְאָר֥וּר אַתָּ֖ה בַּשָּׂדֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’ā·rūr ’at·tāh bā·‘îr wə·’ā·rūr ’at·tāh baś·śā·ḏeh
verses.literal: You will be cursed in the city and cursed . . . in the country
verses.literalPt: Maldito serás tu na cidade, e maldito serás no campo.

verses.original: אָר֥וּר טַנְאֲךָ֖ וּמִשְׁאַרְתֶּֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ā·rūr ṭan·’ă·ḵā ū·miš·’ar·te·ḵā
verses.literal: Your basket and kneading bowl will be cursed
verses.literalPt: Maldito o teu cesto e a tua amassadeira.

verses.original: אָר֥וּר פְּרִֽי־ בִטְנְךָ֖ וּפְרִ֣י אַדְמָתֶ֑ךָ שְׁגַ֥ר אֲלָפֶ֖יךָ וְעַשְׁתְּר֥וֹת צֹאנֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ā·rūr pə·rî- ḇiṭ·nə·ḵā ū·p̄ə·rî ’aḏ·mā·ṯe·ḵā šə·ḡar ’ă·lā·p̄e·ḵā wə·‘aš·tə·rō·wṯ ṣō·ne·ḵā
verses.literal: The fruit of your womb will be cursed as well as the produce of your land the calves of your herds and the lambs of your flocks
verses.literalPt: Maldito o fruto do teu ventre, e o fruto da tua terra, e as crias das tuas vacas, e das tuas ovelhas.

verses.original: אָר֥וּר אַתָּ֖ה בְּבֹאֶ֑ךָ וְאָר֥וּר אַתָּ֖ה בְּצֵאתֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ā·rūr ’at·tāh bə·ḇō·’e·ḵā wə·’ā·rūr ’at·tāh bə·ṣê·ṯe·ḵā
verses.literal: You will be cursed when you come in and cursed when you go out
verses.literalPt: Maldito serás ao entrares, e maldito serás ao saíres.

verses.original: יְשַׁלַּ֣ח יְהוָ֣ה׀ בְּ֠ךָ אֶת־ הַמְּאֵרָ֤ה אֶת־ הַמְּהוּמָה֙ וְאֶת־ הַמִּגְעֶ֔רֶת בְּכָל־ מִשְׁלַ֥ח יָדְךָ֖ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תַּעֲשֶׂ֑ה עַ֣ד הִשָּֽׁמֶדְךָ֤ וְעַד־ אֲבָדְךָ֙ מַהֵ֔ר מִפְּנֵ֛י רֹ֥עַ מַֽעֲלָלֶ֖יךָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר עֲזַבְתָּֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: yə·šal·laḥ Yah·weh bə·ḵā ’eṯ- ham·mə·’ê·rāh ’eṯ- ham·mə·hū·māh wə·’eṯ- ham·miḡ·‘e·reṯ bə·ḵāl miš·laḥ yā·ḏə·ḵā ’ă·šer ta·‘ă·śeh ‘aḏ hiš·šā·meḏ·ḵā wə·‘aḏ- ’ă·ḇā·ḏə·ḵā ma·hêr mip·pə·nê rō·a‘ ma·‘ă·lā·le·ḵā ’ă·šer ‘ă·zaḇ·tā·nî
verses.literal: The LORD will send curses upon you confusion and reproof in all to which you put your hand - until you are destroyed . . . and quickly perish because of the wickedness you have committed in forsaking Him
verses.literalPt: O SENHOR mandará sobre ti a maldição; a confusão e a derrota em tudo em que puseres a mão para fazer; até que sejas destruído, e até que repentinamente pereças, por causa da maldade das tuas obras, pelas quais me deixaste. 21 O SENHOR fará pegar em ti a pestilência, até que te consuma da terra a que passas a possuir.

verses.original: יַדְבֵּ֧ק יְהוָ֛ה בְּךָ֖ אֶת־ הַדָּ֑בֶר עַ֚ד כַּלֹּת֣וֹ אֹֽתְךָ֔ מֵעַל֙ הָֽאֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־ אַתָּ֥ה בָא־ שָׁ֖מָּה לְרִשְׁתָּֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: yaḏ·bêq Yah·weh bə·ḵā ’eṯ- had·dā·ḇer ‘aḏ kal·lō·ṯōw ’ō·ṯə·ḵā mê·‘al hā·’ă·ḏā·māh ’ă·šer- ’at·tāh ḇā- šām·māh lə·riš·tāh
verses.literal: The LORD will make the plague cling to you until He has exterminated you from the land that you are entering . . . to possess
verses.literalPt: Verszeile ohne Text

verses.original: יַכְּכָ֣ה יְ֠הוָה בַּשַּׁחֶ֨פֶת וּבַקַּדַּ֜חַת וּבַדַּלֶּ֗קֶת וּבַֽחַרְחֻר֙ וּבַחֶ֔רֶב וּבַשִּׁדָּפ֖וֹן וּבַיֵּרָק֑וֹן וּרְדָפ֖וּךָ עַ֥ד אָבְדֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: yak·kə·ḵāh Yah·weh baš·ša·ḥe·p̄eṯ ū·ḇaq·qad·da·ḥaṯ ū·ḇad·dal·le·qeṯ ū·ḇa·ḥar·ḥur ū·ḇa·ḥe·reḇ ū·ḇaš·šid·dā·p̄ō·wn ū·ḇay·yê·rā·qō·wn ū·rə·ḏā·p̄ū·ḵā ‘aḏ ’ā·ḇə·ḏe·ḵā
verses.literal: The LORD will strike you with wasting disease with fever and inflammation with scorching heat and drought and with blight and mildew these will pursue you until you perish
verses.literalPt: O SENHOR te ferirá com a tísica e com a febre, e com a inflamação, e com o calor ardente, e com a secura, e com crestamento e com ferrugem; e te perseguirão até que pereças.

verses.original: וְהָי֥וּ שָׁמֶ֛יךָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר עַל־ רֹאשְׁךָ֖ נְחֹ֑שֶׁת וְהָאָ֥רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־ תַּחְתֶּ֖יךָ בַּרְזֶֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yū šā·me·ḵā ’ă·šer ‘al- rō·šə·ḵā nə·ḥō·šeṯ wə·hā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer- taḥ·te·ḵā bar·zel
verses.literal: The sky over your head will be bronze and the earth beneath you iron
verses.literalPt: E os teus céus, que estão sobre a cabeça, serão de bronze; e a terra que está debaixo de ti, será de ferro.

verses.original: יִתֵּ֧ן יְהוָ֛ה אֶת־ מְטַ֥ר אַרְצְךָ֖ אָבָ֣ק וְעָפָ֑ר מִן־ הַשָּׁמַ֙יִם֙ יֵרֵ֣ד עָלֶ֔יךָ עַ֖ד הִשָּׁמְדָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: yit·tên Yah·weh ’eṯ- mə·ṭar ’ar·ṣə·ḵā ’ā·ḇāq wə·‘ā·p̄ār min- haš·šā·ma·yim yê·rêḏ ‘ā·le·ḵā ‘aḏ hiš·šā·mə·ḏāḵ
verses.literal: The LORD will turn the rain of your land into dust and powder it will descend on you from the sky until you are destroyed
verses.literalPt: O SENHOR dará por chuva sobre a tua terra, pó e poeira; dos céus descerá sobre ti, até que pereças.

verses.original: יִתֶּנְךָ֨ יְהוָ֥ה׀ נִגָּף֮ לִפְנֵ֣י אֹיְבֶיךָ֒ בְּדֶ֤רֶךְ אֶחָד֙ תֵּצֵ֣א אֵלָ֔יו וּבְשִׁבְעָ֥ה דְרָכִ֖ים תָּנ֣וּס לְפָנָ֑יו וְהָיִ֣יתָ לְזַעֲוָ֔ה לְכֹ֖ל מַמְלְכ֥וֹת הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: yit·ten·ḵā Yah·weh nig·gāp̄ lip̄·nê ’ō·yə·ḇe·ḵā bə·ḏe·reḵ ’e·ḥāḏ tê·ṣê ’ê·lāw ū·ḇə·šiḇ·‘āh ḏə·rā·ḵîm tā·nūs lə·p̄ā·nāw wə·hā·yî·ṯā lə·za·‘ă·wāh lə·ḵōl mam·lə·ḵō·wṯ hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: The LORD will cause you to be defeated before your enemies You will march out against them in one direction but flee from them in seven You will be an object of horror to all the kingdoms of the earth
verses.literalPt: O SENHOR te fará cair diante dos teus inimigos; por um caminho sairás contra eles, e por sete caminhos fugirás de diante deles, e serás espalhado por todos os reinos da terra.

verses.original: וְהָיְתָ֤ה נִבְלָֽתְךָ֙ לְמַאֲכָ֔ל לְכָל־ ע֥וֹף הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם וּלְבֶהֱמַ֣ת הָאָ֑רֶץ וְאֵ֖ין מַחֲרִֽיד׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yə·ṯāh niḇ·lā·ṯə·ḵā lə·ma·’ă·ḵāl lə·ḵāl ‘ō·wp̄ haš·šā·ma·yim ū·lə·ḇe·hĕ·maṯ hā·’ā·reṣ wə·’ên ma·ḥă·rîḏ
verses.literal: Your corpses will be food for all the birds of the air and beasts of the earth with no one to scare them away
verses.literalPt: E o teu cadáver servirá de comida a todas as aves dos céus, e aos animais da terra; e ninguém os espantará.

verses.original: יַכְּכָ֨ה יְהוָ֜ה בִּשְׁחִ֤ין מִצְרַ֙יִם֙ וּבָעֳפָלִים וּבַגָּרָ֖ב וּבֶחָ֑רֶס אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא־ תוּכַ֖ל לְהֵרָפֵֽא׃
verses.transliteration: yak·kə·ḵāh Yah·weh biš·ḥîn miṣ·ra·yim ū·ḇå̄·ʿo·p̄å̄·līm ū·ḇag·gā·rāḇ ū·ḇe·ḥā·res ’ă·šer lō- ṯū·ḵal lə·hê·rā·p̄ê
verses.literal: The LORD will afflict you with the boils of Egypt with tumors and scabs and itch from which you cannot . . . be cured
verses.literalPt: O SENHOR te ferirá com as úlceras do Egito, com tumores, e com sarna, e com coceira, de que não possas curar-te;

verses.original: יַכְּכָ֣ה יְהוָ֔ה בְּשִׁגָּע֖וֹן וּבְעִוָּר֑וֹן וּבְתִמְה֖וֹן לֵבָֽב׃
verses.transliteration: yak·kə·ḵāh Yah·weh bə·šig·gā·‘ō·wn ū·ḇə·‘iw·wā·rō·wn ū·ḇə·ṯim·hō·wn lê·ḇāḇ
verses.literal: The LORD will afflict you with madness blindness and confusion of mind
verses.literalPt: O SENHOR te ferirá com loucura, e com cegueira, e com pasmo de coração;

verses.original: וְהָיִ֜יתָ מְמַשֵּׁ֣שׁ בַּֽצָּהֳרַ֗יִם כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר יְמַשֵּׁ֤שׁ הָעִוֵּר֙ בָּאֲפֵלָ֔ה וְלֹ֥א תַצְלִ֖יחַ אֶת־ דְּרָכֶ֑יךָ וְהָיִ֜יתָ אַ֣ךְ עָשׁ֧וּק וְגָז֛וּל כָּל־ הַיָּמִ֖ים וְאֵ֥ין מוֹשִֽׁיעַ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yî·ṯā mə·maš·šêš baṣ·ṣā·ho·ra·yim ka·’ă·šer yə·maš·šêš hā·‘iw·wêr bā·’ă·p̄ê·lāh wə·lō ṯaṣ·lî·aḥ ’eṯ- də·rā·ḵe·ḵā wə·hā·yî·ṯā ’aḵ ‘ā·šūq wə·ḡā·zūl kāl- hay·yā·mîm wə·’ên mō·wō·šî·a‘
verses.literal: and at noon you will grope about like a blind man in the darkness You will not prosper in your ways Day after day you will be oppressed and plundered . . . with no one to save you
verses.literalPt: E apalparás ao meio dia, como o cego apalpa na escuridão, e não prosperarás nos teus caminhos; porém somente serás oprimido e roubado todos os dias, e não haverá quem te salve.

verses.original: אִשָּׁ֣ה תְאָרֵ֗שׂ וְאִ֤ישׁ אַחֵר֙ יִשְׁגָּלֶנָּה בַּ֥יִת תִּבְנֶ֖ה וְלֹא־ תֵשֵׁ֣ב בּ֑וֹ כֶּ֥רֶם תִּטַּ֖ע וְלֹ֥א תְחַלְּלֶּֽנּוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ’iš·šāh ṯə·’ā·rêś wə·’îš ’a·ḥêr yiš·gå̄·lɛn·nå̄h ba·yiṯ tiḇ·neh wə·lō- ṯê·šêḇ bōw ke·rem tiṭ·ṭa‘ wə·lō ṯə·ḥal·ləl·lɛn·nū
verses.literal: You will be pledged in marriage to a woman but another man will violate her You will build a house but will not live in it You will plant a vineyard but will not enjoy its fruit
verses.literalPt: Desposar-te-ás com uma mulher, porém outro homem dormirá com ela; edificarás uma casa, porém não morarás nela; plantarás uma vinha, porém não aproveitarás o seu fruto.

verses.original: שׁוֹרְךָ֞ טָב֣וּחַ לְעֵינֶ֗יךָ וְלֹ֣א תֹאכַל֮ מִמֶּנּוּ֒ חֲמֹֽרְךָ֙ גָּז֣וּל מִלְּפָנֶ֔יךָ וְלֹ֥א יָשׁ֖וּב לָ֑ךְ צֹֽאנְךָ֙ נְתֻנ֣וֹת לְאֹיְבֶ֔יךָ וְאֵ֥ין לְךָ֖ מוֹשִֽׁיעַ׃
verses.transliteration: šō·wr·ḵā ṭā·ḇū·aḥ lə·‘ê·ne·ḵā wə·lō ṯō·ḵal mim·men·nū ḥă·mō·rə·ḵā gā·zūl mil·lə·p̄ā·ne·ḵā wə·lō yā·šūḇ lāḵ ṣō·nə·ḵā nə·ṯu·nō·wṯ lə·’ō·yə·ḇe·ḵā wə·’ên lə·ḵā mō·wō·šî·a‘
verses.literal: Your ox will be slaughtered before your eyes but you will not eat any of it Your donkey will be taken away and not returned to you Your flock will be given to your enemies and no one will save you
verses.literalPt: O teu boi será morto aos teus olhos, porém dele não comerás; o teu jumento será roubado diante de ti, e não voltará a ti; as tuas ovelhas serão dadas aos teus inimigos, e não haverá quem te salve.

verses.original: בָּנֶ֨יךָ וּבְנֹתֶ֜יךָ נְתֻנִ֨ים לְעַ֤ם אַחֵר֙ וְעֵינֶ֣יךָ רֹא֔וֹת וְכָל֥וֹת אֲלֵיהֶ֖ם כָּל־ הַיּ֑וֹם וְאֵ֥ין לְאֵ֖ל יָדֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: bā·ne·ḵā ū·ḇə·nō·ṯe·ḵā nə·ṯu·nîm lə·‘am ’a·ḥêr wə·‘ê·ne·ḵā rō·’ō·wṯ wə·ḵā·lō·wṯ ’ă·lê·hem kāl- hay·yō·wm wə·’ên lə·’êl yā·ḏe·ḵā
verses.literal: Your sons and daughters will be given to another nation while your eyes grow weary looking for them day after day with no power in your hand
verses.literalPt: Teus filhos e tuas filhas serão dados a outro povo, os teus olhos o verão, e por eles desfalecerão todo o dia; porém não haverá poder na tua mão.

verses.original: פְּרִ֤י אַדְמָֽתְךָ֙ וְכָל־ יְגִ֣יעֲךָ֔ יֹאכַ֥ל עַ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹא־ יָדָ֑עְתָּ וְהָיִ֗יתָ רַ֛ק עָשׁ֥וּק וְרָצ֖וּץ כָּל־ הַיָּמִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: pə·rî ’aḏ·mā·ṯə·ḵā wə·ḵāl yə·ḡî·‘ă·ḵā yō·ḵal ‘am ’ă·šer lō- yā·ḏā·‘ə·tā wə·hā·yî·ṯā raq ‘ā·šūq wə·rā·ṣūṣ kāl- hay·yā·mîm
verses.literal: A people you do not know will eat the produce of your land and of all your toil All your days you will be oppressed and crushed
verses.literalPt: O fruto da tua terra e todo o teu trabalho, comerá um povo que nunca conheceste; e tu serás oprimido e quebrantado todos os dias.

verses.original: וְהָיִ֖יתָ מְשֻׁגָּ֑ע מִמַּרְאֵ֥ה עֵינֶ֖יךָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר תִּרְאֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yî·ṯā mə·šug·gā‘ mim·mar·’êh ‘ê·ne·ḵā ’ă·šer tir·’eh
verses.literal: You will be driven mad by the sights . . . you see
verses.literalPt: E enlouquecerás com o que vires com os teus olhos.

verses.original: יַכְּכָ֨ה יְהוָ֜ה בִּשְׁחִ֣ין רָ֗ע עַל־ הַבִּרְכַּ֙יִם֙ וְעַל־ הַשֹּׁקַ֔יִם אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא־ תוּכַ֖ל לְהֵרָפֵ֑א מִכַּ֥ף רַגְלְךָ֖ וְעַ֥ד קָדְקֳדֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: yak·kə·ḵāh Yah·weh biš·ḥîn rā‘ ‘al- hab·bir·ka·yim wə·‘al- haš·šō·qa·yim ’ă·šer lō- ṯū·ḵal lə·hê·rā·p̄ê mik·kap̄ raḡ·lə·ḵā wə·‘aḏ qā·ḏə·qo·ḏe·ḵā
verses.literal: The LORD will afflict you with painful incurable . . . boils on your knees . . . and thighs from the soles of your feet to the top of your head
verses.literalPt: O SENHOR te ferirá com úlceras malignas nos joelhos e nas pernas, de que não possas sarar, desde a planta do teu pé até ao alto da cabeça.

verses.original: יוֹלֵ֨ךְ יְהוָ֜ה אֹֽתְךָ֗ וְאֶֽת־ מַלְכְּךָ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תָּקִ֣ים עָלֶ֔יךָ אֶל־ גּ֕וֹי אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא־ יָדַ֖עְתָּ אַתָּ֣ה וַאֲבֹתֶ֑יךָ וְעָבַ֥דְתָּ שָּׁ֛ם אֱלֹהִ֥ים אֲחֵרִ֖ים עֵ֥ץ וָאָֽבֶן׃
verses.transliteration: yō·w·lêḵ Yah·weh ’ō·ṯə·ḵā wə·’eṯ- mal·kə·ḵā ’ă·šer tā·qîm ‘ā·le·ḵā ’el- gō·w ’ă·šer lō- yā·ḏa‘·tā ’at·tāh wa·’ă·ḇō·ṯe·ḵā wə·‘ā·ḇaḏ·tā šām ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’ă·ḥê·rîm ‘êṣ wā·’ā·ḇen
verses.literal: The LORD will bring you and the king you appoint . . . to a nation neither you nor your fathers have known and there you will worship other gods gods of wood and stone
verses.literalPt: O SENHOR te levará a ti e a teu rei, que tiveres posto sobre ti, a uma nação que não conheceste, nem tu nem teus pais; e ali servirás a outros deuses, ao pau e à pedra.

verses.original: וְהָיִ֣יתָ לְשַׁמָּ֔ה לְמָשָׁ֖ל וְלִשְׁנִינָ֑ה בְּכֹל֙ הָֽעַמִּ֔ים אֲשֶׁר־ יְנַהֶגְךָ֥ יְהוָ֖ה שָֽׁמָּה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yî·ṯā lə·šam·māh lə·mā·šāl wə·liš·nî·nāh bə·ḵōl hā·‘am·mîm ’ă·šer- yə·na·heḡ·ḵā Yah·weh šām·māh
verses.literal: You will become an object of horror scorn and ridicule among all the nations to which the LORD . . . will drive you
verses.literalPt: E serás por pasmo, por ditado, e por fábula, entre todos os povos a que o SENHOR te levará.

verses.original: זֶ֥רַע רַ֖ב תּוֹצִ֣יא הַשָּׂדֶ֑ה וּמְעַ֣ט תֶּאֱסֹ֔ף כִּ֥י יַחְסְלֶ֖נּוּ הָאַרְבֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ze·ra‘ raḇ tō·w·ṣî haś·śā·ḏeh ū·mə·‘aṭ te·’ĕ·sōp̄ kî yaḥ·sə·len·nū hā·’ar·beh
verses.literal: You will sow much seed in the field but harvest little because the locusts will consume it
verses.literalPt: Lançarás muita semente ao campo; porém colherás pouco, porque o gafanhoto a consumirá.

verses.original: כְּרָמִ֥ים תִּטַּ֖ע וְעָבָ֑דְתָּ וְיַ֤יִן לֹֽא־ תִשְׁתֶּה֙ וְלֹ֣א תֶאֱגֹ֔ר כִּ֥י תֹאכְלֶ֖נּוּ הַתֹּלָֽעַת׃
verses.transliteration: kə·rā·mîm tiṭ·ṭa‘ wə·‘ā·ḇā·ḏə·tā wə·ya·yin lō- ṯiš·teh wə·lō ṯe·’ĕ·ḡōr kî ṯō·ḵə·len·nū hat·tō·lā·‘aṯ
verses.literal: You will plant and cultivate vineyards but will neither drink the wine nor gather the grapes because worms will eat them
verses.literalPt: Plantarás vinhas, e cultivarás; porém não beberás vinho, nem colherás as uvas; porque o bicho as colherá.

verses.original: זֵיתִ֛ים יִהְי֥וּ לְךָ֖ בְּכָל־ גְּבוּלֶ֑ךָ וְשֶׁ֙מֶן֙ לֹ֣א תָס֔וּךְ כִּ֥י יִשַּׁ֖ל זֵיתֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: zê·ṯîm yih·yū lə·ḵā bə·ḵāl gə·ḇū·le·ḵā wə·še·men lō ṯā·sūḵ kî yiš·šal zê·ṯe·ḵā
verses.literal: You will have olive trees throughout your territory but will never anoint yourself with oil because the olives will drop off
verses.literalPt: Em todos os termos terás oliveiras; porém não te ungirás com azeite; porque a azeitona cairá da tua oliveira.

verses.original: בָּנִ֥ים וּבָנ֖וֹת תּוֹלִ֑יד וְלֹא־ יִהְי֣וּ לָ֔ךְ כִּ֥י יֵלְכ֖וּ בַּשֶּֽׁבִי׃
verses.transliteration: bā·nîm ū·ḇā·nō·wṯ tō·w·lîḏ wə·lō- yih·yū lāḵ kî yê·lə·ḵū baš·še·ḇî
verses.literal: You will father sons and daughters but they will not remain yours because they will go into captivity
verses.literalPt: Filhos e filhas gerarás; porém não serão para ti; porque irão em cativeiro.

verses.original: כָּל־ עֵצְךָ֖ וּפְרִ֣י אַדְמָתֶ֑ךָ יְיָרֵ֖שׁ הַצְּלָצַֽל׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- ‘ê·ṣə·ḵā ū·p̄ə·rî ’aḏ·mā·ṯe·ḵā yə·yā·rêš haṣ·ṣə·lā·ṣal
verses.literal: Swarms of locusts will consume all your trees and the produce of your land
verses.literalPt: Todo o teu arvoredo e o fruto da tua terra consumirá a lagarta.

verses.original: הַגֵּר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּקִרְבְּךָ֔ יַעֲלֶ֥ה עָלֶ֖יךָ מַ֣עְלָה מָּ֑עְלָה וְאַתָּ֥ה תֵרֵ֖ד מַ֥טָּה מָּֽטָּה׃
verses.transliteration: hag·gêr ’ă·šer bə·qir·bə·ḵā ya·‘ă·leh ‘ā·le·ḵā ma‘·lāh mā·‘ə·lāh wə·’at·tāh ṯê·rêḏ maṭ·ṭāh māṭ·ṭāh
verses.literal: The foreigner living among you will rise higher and higher above you while you sink down lower and lower
verses.literalPt: O estrangeiro, que está no meio de ti, se elevará muito sobre ti, e tu mais baixo descerás;

verses.original: ה֣וּא יַלְוְךָ֔ וְאַתָּ֖ה לֹ֣א תַלְוֶ֑נּוּ ה֚וּא יִהְיֶ֣ה לְרֹ֔אשׁ וְאַתָּ֖ה תִּֽהְיֶ֥ה לְזָנָֽב׃
verses.transliteration: hū yal·wə·ḵā wə·’at·tāh lō ṯal·wen·nū hū yih·yeh lə·rōš wə·’at·tāh tih·yeh lə·zā·nāḇ
verses.literal: He will lend to you but you will not lend to him He will be the head and you will be the tail
verses.literalPt: Ele te emprestará a ti, porém tu não emprestarás a ele; ele será por cabeça, e tu serás por cauda.

verses.original: וּבָ֨אוּ עָלֶ֜יךָ כָּל־ הַקְּלָל֣וֹת הָאֵ֗לֶּה וּרְדָפ֙וּךָ֙ וְהִשִּׂיג֔וּךָ עַ֖ד הִשָּֽׁמְדָ֑ךְ כִּי־ לֹ֣א שָׁמַ֗עְתָּ בְּקוֹל֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ לִשְׁמֹ֛ר מִצְוֺתָ֥יו וְחֻקֹּתָ֖יו אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוָּֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇā·’ū ‘ā·le·ḵā kāl- haq·qə·lā·lō·wṯ hā·’êl·leh ū·rə·ḏā·p̄ū·ḵā wə·hiś·śî·ḡū·ḵā ‘aḏ hiš·šā·mə·ḏāḵ kî- lō šā·ma‘·tā bə·qō·wl Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā liš·mōr miṣ·wō·ṯāw wə·ḥuq·qō·ṯāw ’ă·šer ṣiw·wāḵ
verses.literal: All these curses will come upon you They will pursue you and overtake you until you are destroyed since you did not obey . . . the LORD your God and keep the commandments and statutes He gave you
verses.literalPt: E todas estas maldições virão sobre ti, e te perseguirão, e te alcançarão, até que sejas destruído; porquanto não ouviste à voz do SENHOR teu Deus, para guardares os seus mandamentos, e os seus estatutos, que te tem ordenado;

verses.original: וְהָי֣וּ בְךָ֔ לְא֖וֹת וּלְמוֹפֵ֑ת וּֽבְזַרְעֲךָ֖ עַד־ עוֹלָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yū ḇə·ḵā lə·’ō·wṯ ū·lə·mō·w·p̄êṯ ū·ḇə·zar·‘ă·ḵā ‘aḏ- ‘ō·w·lām
verses.literal: These curses will be a sign and a wonder upon you and your descendants forever . . .
verses.literalPt: E serão entre ti por sinal e por maravilha, como também entre a tua descendência para sempre.

verses.original: תַּ֗חַת אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹא־ עָבַ֙דְתָּ֙ אֶת־ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ בְּשִׂמְחָ֖ה וּבְט֣וּב לֵבָ֑ב מֵרֹ֖ב כֹּֽל׃
verses.transliteration: ta·ḥaṯ ’ă·šer lō- ‘ā·ḇaḏ·tā ’eṯ- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā bə·śim·ḥāh ū·ḇə·ṭūḇ lê·ḇāḇ mê·rōḇ kōl
verses.literal: Because you did not serve the LORD your God with joy and gladness of heart in all your abundance
verses.literalPt: Porquanto não serviste ao SENHOR teu Deus com alegria e bondade de coração, pela abundância de tudo.

verses.original: וְעָבַדְתָּ֣ אֶת־ אֹיְבֶ֗יךָ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יְשַׁלְּחֶ֤נּוּ יְהוָה֙ בָּ֔ךְ בְּרָעָ֧ב וּבְצָמָ֛א וּבְעֵירֹ֖ם וּבְחֹ֣סֶר כֹּ֑ל וְנָתַ֞ן עֹ֤ל בַּרְזֶל֙ עַל־ צַוָּארֶ֔ךָ עַ֥ד הִשְׁמִיד֖וֹ אֹתָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ā·ḇaḏ·tā ’eṯ- ’ō·yə·ḇe·ḵā ’ă·šer yə·šal·lə·ḥen·nū Yah·weh bāḵ bə·rā·‘āḇ ū·ḇə·ṣā·mā ū·ḇə·‘ê·rōm ū·ḇə·ḥō·ser kōl wə·nā·ṯan ‘ōl bar·zel ‘al- ṣaw·wā·re·ḵā ‘aḏ hiš·mî·ḏōw ’ō·ṯāḵ
verses.literal: you will serve your enemies the LORD will send against you in famine thirst nakedness and destitution . . . He will place an iron yoke on your neck until He has destroyed you
verses.literalPt: Assim servirás aos teus inimigos, que o SENHOR enviará contra ti, com fome e com sede, e com nudez, e com falta de tudo; e sobre o teu pescoço porá um jugo de ferro, até que te tenha destruído.

verses.original: יִשָּׂ֣א יְהוָה֩ עָלֶ֨יךָ גּ֤וֹי מֵרָחוֹק֙ מִקְצֵ֣ה הָאָ֔רֶץ כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר יִדְאֶ֖ה הַנָּ֑שֶׁר גּ֕וֹי אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא־ תִשְׁמַ֖ע לְשֹׁנֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: yiś·śā Yah·weh ‘ā·le·ḵā gō·w mê·rā·ḥō·wq miq·ṣêh hā·’ā·reṣ ka·’ă·šer yiḏ·’eh han·nā·šer gō·w ’ă·šer lō- ṯiš·ma‘ lə·šō·nōw
verses.literal: The LORD will bring a nation from afar from the ends of the earth to swoop down upon you like an eagle a nation whose language you will not understand
verses.literalPt: O SENHOR levantará contra ti uma nação de longe, da extremidade da terra, que voa como a águia, nação cuja língua não entenderás;

verses.original: גּ֖וֹי עַ֣ז פָּנִ֑ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר לֹא־ יִשָּׂ֤א פָנִים֙ לְזָקֵ֔ן וְנַ֖עַר לֹ֥א יָחֹֽן׃
verses.transliteration: gō·w ‘az pā·nîm ’ă·šer lō- yiś·śā p̄ā·nîm lə·zā·qên wə·na·‘ar lō yā·ḥōn
verses.literal: a ruthless . . . nation with no respect . . . for the old and no pity for the young
verses.literalPt: Nação feroz de rosto, que não respeitará o rosto do velho, nem se apiedará do moço;

verses.original: וְ֠אָכַל פְּרִ֨י בְהֶמְתְּךָ֥ וּפְרִֽי־ אַדְמָתְךָ֮ עַ֣ד הִשָּֽׁמְדָךְ֒ אֲשֶׁ֨ר לֹֽא־ יַשְׁאִ֜יר לְךָ֗ דָּגָן֙ תִּיר֣וֹשׁ וְיִצְהָ֔ר שְׁגַ֥ר אֲלָפֶ֖יךָ וְעַשְׁתְּרֹ֣ת צֹאנֶ֑ךָ עַ֥ד הַאֲבִיד֖וֹ אֹתָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ā·ḵal pə·rî ḇə·hem·tə·ḵā ū·p̄ə·rî- ’aḏ·mā·ṯə·ḵā ‘aḏ hiš·šā·mə·ḏāḵ ’ă·šer lō- yaš·’îr lə·ḵā dā·ḡān tî·rō·wōš wə·yiṣ·hār šə·ḡar ’ă·lā·p̄e·ḵā wə·‘aš·tə·rōṯ ṣō·ne·ḵā ‘aḏ ha·’ă·ḇî·ḏōw ’ō·ṯāḵ
verses.literal: They will eat the offspring of your livestock and the produce of your land until you are destroyed They will leave you no grain or new wine or oil no calves of your herds or lambs of your flocks until they have caused you to perish
verses.literalPt: E comerá o fruto dos teus animais, e o fruto da tua terra, até que sejas destruído; e não te deixará grão, mosto, nem azeite, nem crias das tuas vacas, nem das tuas ovelhas, até que te haja consumido;

verses.original: וְהֵצַ֨ר לְךָ֜ בְּכָל־ שְׁעָרֶ֗יךָ עַ֣ד רֶ֤דֶת חֹמֹתֶ֙יךָ֙ הַגְּבֹה֣וֹת וְהַבְּצֻר֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר אַתָּ֛ה בֹּטֵ֥חַ בָּהֵ֖ן בְּכָל־ אַרְצֶ֑ךָ וְהֵצַ֤ר לְךָ֙ בְּכָל־ שְׁעָרֶ֔יךָ בְּכָ֨ל־ אַרְצְךָ֔ אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָתַ֛ן יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ לָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hê·ṣar lə·ḵā bə·ḵāl šə·‘ā·re·ḵā ‘aḏ re·ḏeṯ ḥō·mō·ṯe·ḵā hag·gə·ḇō·hō·wṯ wə·hab·bə·ṣu·rō·wṯ ’ă·šer ’at·tāh bō·ṭê·aḥ bā·hên bə·ḵāl ’ar·ṣe·ḵā wə·hê·ṣar lə·ḵā bə·ḵāl šə·‘ā·re·ḵā bə·ḵāl ’ar·ṣə·ḵā ’ă·šer nā·ṯan Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā lāḵ
verses.literal: They will besiege all the cities throughout your land until the high and fortified walls in which you trust have fallen They will besiege all your cities throughout the land that the LORD your God has given you
verses.literalPt: E sitiar-te-á em todas as tuas portas, até que venham a cair os teus altos e fortes muros, em que confiavas em toda a tua terra; e te sitiará em todas as tuas portas, em toda a tua terra que te tem dado o SENHOR teu Deus.

verses.original: וְאָכַלְתָּ֣ פְרִֽי־ בִטְנְךָ֗ בְּשַׂ֤ר בָּנֶ֙יךָ֙ וּבְנֹתֶ֔יךָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָֽתַן־ לְךָ֖ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ בְּמָצוֹר֙ וּבְמָצ֔וֹק אֲשֶׁר־ יָצִ֥יק לְךָ֖ אֹיְבֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ā·ḵal·tā p̄ə·rî- ḇiṭ·nə·ḵā bə·śar bā·ne·ḵā ū·ḇə·nō·ṯe·ḵā ’ă·šer nā·ṯan- lə·ḵā Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā bə·mā·ṣō·wr ū·ḇə·mā·ṣō·wq ’ă·šer- yā·ṣîq lə·ḵā ’ō·yə·ḇe·ḵā
verses.literal: Then you will eat the fruit of your womb the flesh of the sons and daughters whom the LORD your God has given you in the siege and distress that your enemy will inflict on you
verses.literalPt: E comerás o fruto do teu ventre, a carne de teus filhos e de tuas filhas, que te der o SENHOR teu Deus, no cerco e no aperto com que os teus inimigos te apertarão.

verses.original: הָאִישׁ֙ הָרַ֣ךְ בְּךָ֔ וְהֶעָנֹ֖ג מְאֹ֑ד תֵּרַ֨ע עֵינ֤וֹ בְאָחִיו֙ וּבְאֵ֣שֶׁת חֵיק֔וֹ וּבְיֶ֥תֶר בָּנָ֖יו אֲשֶׁ֥ר יוֹתִֽיר׃
verses.transliteration: hā·’îš hā·raḵ bə·ḵā wə·he·‘ā·nōḡ mə·’ōḏ tê·ra‘ ‘ê·nōw ḇə·’ā·ḥîw ū·ḇə·’ê·šeṯ ḥê·qōw ū·ḇə·ye·ṯer bā·nāw ’ă·šer yō·w·ṯîr
verses.literal: The most gentle and refined man among you will begrudge . . . his brother the wife he embraces and the rest of his children who have survived
verses.literalPt: Quanto ao homem mais mimoso e delicado no meio de ti, o seu olho será maligno para com o seu irmão, e para com a mulher do seu regaço, e para com os demais de seus filhos que ainda lhe ficarem;

verses.original: מִתֵּ֣ת׀ לְאַחַ֣ד מֵהֶ֗ם מִבְּשַׂ֤ר בָּנָיו֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יֹאכֵ֔ל מִבְּלִ֥י הִשְׁאִֽיר־ ל֖וֹ כֹּ֑ל בְּמָצוֹר֙ וּבְמָצ֔וֹק אֲשֶׁ֨ר יָצִ֥יק לְךָ֛ אֹיִבְךָ֖ בְּכָל־ שְׁעָרֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: mit·têṯ lə·’a·ḥaḏ mê·hem mib·bə·śar bā·nāw ’ă·šer yō·ḵêl mib·bə·lî hiš·’îr- lōw kōl bə·mā·ṣō·wr ū·ḇə·mā·ṣō·wq ’ă·šer yā·ṣîq lə·ḵā ’ō·yiḇ·ḵā bə·ḵāl šə·‘ā·re·ḵā
verses.literal: refusing to share with any of them the flesh of his children he will eat because he has nothing . . . . . . left in the siege and distress that your enemy will inflict on you within all your gates
verses.literalPt: De sorte que não dará a nenhum deles da carne de seus filhos, que ele comer; porquanto nada lhe ficou de resto no cerco e no aperto, com que o teu inimigo te apertará em todas as tuas portas.

verses.original: הָרַכָּ֨ה בְךָ֜ וְהָעֲנֻגָּ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר לֹא־ נִסְּתָ֤ה כַף־ רַגְלָהּ֙ הַצֵּ֣ג עַל־ הָאָ֔רֶץ מֵהִתְעַנֵּ֖ג וּמֵרֹ֑ךְ תֵּרַ֤ע עֵינָהּ֙ בְּאִ֣ישׁ חֵיקָ֔הּ וּבִבְנָ֖הּ וּבְבִתָּֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: hā·rak·kāh ḇə·ḵā wə·hā·‘ă·nug·gāh ’ă·šer lō- nis·sə·ṯāh ḵap̄- raḡ·lāh haṣ·ṣêḡ ‘al- hā·’ā·reṣ mê·hiṯ·‘an·nêḡ ū·mê·rōḵ tê·ra‘ ‘ê·nāh bə·’îš ḥê·qāh ū·ḇiḇ·nāh ū·ḇə·ḇit·tāh
verses.literal: The most gentle and refined woman among you so gentle and refined she would not venture to set the sole of her foot on the ground will begrudge . . . the husband she embraces and her son and daughter
verses.literalPt: E quanto à mulher mais mimosa e delicada no meio de ti, que de mimo e delicadeza nunca tentou pôr a planta de seu pé sobre a terra, será maligno o seu olho contra o homem de seu regaço, e contra seu filho, e contra sua filha;

verses.original: וּֽבְשִׁלְיָתָ֞הּ הַיּוֹצֵ֣ת׀ מִבֵּ֣ין רַגְלֶ֗יהָ וּבְבָנֶ֙יהָ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תֵּלֵ֔ד כִּֽי־ תֹאכְלֵ֥ם בְּחֹֽסֶר־ כֹּ֖ל בַּסָּ֑תֶר בְּמָצוֹר֙ וּבְמָצ֔וֹק אֲשֶׁ֨ר יָצִ֥יק לְךָ֛ אֹיִבְךָ֖ בִּשְׁעָרֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·šil·yā·ṯāh hay·yō·w·ṣêṯ mib·bên raḡ·le·hā ū·ḇə·ḇā·ne·hā ’ă·šer tê·lêḏ kî- ṯō·ḵə·lêm bə·ḥō·ser- kōl bas·sā·ṯer bə·mā·ṣō·wr ū·ḇə·mā·ṣō·wq ’ă·šer yā·ṣîq lə·ḵā ’ō·yiḇ·ḵā biš·‘ā·re·ḵā
verses.literal: the afterbirth that comes from between her legs and the children she bears because she will secretly eat them for lack of anything else in the siege and distress that your enemy will inflict on you within your gates
verses.literalPt: E isto por causa de suas páreas, que saírem dentre os seus pés, e para com os seus filhos que tiver, porque os comerá às escondidas pela falta de tudo, no cerco e no aperto, com que o teu inimigo te apertará nas tuas portas.

verses.original: אִם־ לֹ֨א תִשְׁמֹ֜ר לַעֲשׂ֗וֹת אֶת־ כָּל־ דִּבְרֵי֙ הַתּוֹרָ֣ה הַזֹּ֔את הַכְּתוּבִ֖ים בַּסֵּ֣פֶר הַזֶּ֑ה לְ֠יִרְאָה אֶת־ הַשֵּׁ֞ם הַנִּכְבָּ֤ד וְהַנּוֹרָא֙ הַזֶּ֔ה אֵ֖ת יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- lō ṯiš·mōr la·‘ă·śō·wṯ ’eṯ- kāl- diḇ·rê hat·tō·w·rāh haz·zōṯ hak·kə·ṯū·ḇîm bas·sê·p̄er haz·zeh lə·yir·’āh ’eṯ- haš·šêm han·niḵ·bāḏ wə·han·nō·w·rā haz·zeh ’êṯ Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā
verses.literal: If you are not careful to observe all the words of this law which are written in this book that you may fear this glorious and awesome . . . name the LORD your God
verses.literalPt: Se não tiveres cuidado de guardar todas as palavras desta lei, que estão escritas neste livro, para temeres este nome glorioso e temível, O SENHOR TEU DEUS,

verses.original: וְהִפְלָ֤א יְהוָה֙ אֶת־ מַכֹּ֣תְךָ֔ וְאֵ֖ת מַכּ֣וֹת זַרְעֶ֑ךָ מַכּ֤וֹת גְּדֹלוֹת֙ וְנֶ֣אֱמָנ֔וֹת וָחֳלָיִ֥ם רָעִ֖ים וְנֶאֱמָנִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hip̄·lā Yah·weh ’eṯ- mak·kō·ṯə·ḵā wə·’êṯ mak·kō·wṯ zar·‘e·ḵā mak·kō·wṯ gə·ḏō·lō·wṯ wə·ne·’ĕ·mā·nō·wṯ wā·ḥo·lā·yim rā·‘îm wə·ne·’ĕ·mā·nîm
verses.literal: He - will bring upon you and your descendants extraordinary disasters . . . severe and lasting plagues and terrible and chronic sicknesses
verses.literalPt: Então o SENHOR fará espantosas as tuas pragas, e as pragas de tua descendência, grandes e permanentes pragas, e enfermidades malignas e duradouras;

verses.original: וְהֵשִׁ֣יב בְּךָ֗ אֵ֚ת כָּל־ מַדְוֵ֣ה מִצְרַ֔יִם אֲשֶׁ֥ר יָגֹ֖רְתָּ מִפְּנֵיהֶ֑ם וְדָבְק֖וּ בָּֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hê·šîḇ bə·ḵā ’êṯ kāl- maḏ·wêh miṣ·ra·yim ’ă·šer yā·ḡō·rə·tā mip·pə·nê·hem wə·ḏā·ḇə·qū bāḵ
verses.literal: He will afflict you again with all the diseases you dreaded in Egypt . . . and they will cling to you
verses.literalPt: E fará tornar sobre ti todos os males do Egito, de que tu tiveste temor, e se apegarão a ti.

verses.original: גַּ֤ם כָּל־ חֳלִי֙ וְכָל־ מַכָּ֔ה אֲשֶׁר֙ לֹ֣א כָת֔וּב בְּסֵ֖פֶר הַתּוֹרָ֣ה הַזֹּ֑את יַעְלֵ֤ם יְהוָה֙ עָלֶ֔יךָ עַ֖ד הִשָּׁמְדָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: gam kāl- ḥo·lî wə·ḵāl mak·kāh ’ă·šer lō ḵā·ṯūḇ bə·sê·p̄er hat·tō·w·rāh haz·zōṯ ya‘·lêm Yah·weh ‘ā·le·ḵā ‘aḏ hiš·šā·mə·ḏāḵ
verses.literal: The LORD will also bring upon you every sickness . . . and plague not recorded in this Book of the Law until you are destroyed
verses.literalPt: Também o SENHOR fará vir sobre ti toda a enfermidade e toda a praga, que não está escrita no livro desta lei, até que sejas destruído.

verses.original: וְנִשְׁאַרְתֶּם֙ בִּמְתֵ֣י מְעָ֔ט תַּ֚חַת אֲשֶׁ֣ר הֱיִיתֶ֔ם כְּכוֹכְבֵ֥י הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם לָרֹ֑ב כִּי־ לֹ֣א שָׁמַ֔עְתָּ בְּק֖וֹל יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·niš·’ar·tem bim·ṯê mə·‘āṭ ta·ḥaṯ ’ă·šer hĕ·yî·ṯem kə·ḵō·wḵ·ḇê haš·šā·ma·yim lā·rōḇ kî- lō šā·ma‘·tā bə·qō·wl Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā
verses.literal: You who were as numerous as the stars in the sky will be left few in number because you would not obey the voice of the LORD your God
verses.literalPt: E ficareis poucos em número, em lugar de haverem sido como as estrelas dos céus em multidão; porquanto não destes ouvidos à voz do SENHOR teu Deus.

verses.original: וְ֠הָיָה כַּאֲשֶׁר־ שָׂ֨שׂ יְהוָ֜ה עֲלֵיכֶ֗ם לְהֵיטִ֣יב אֶתְכֶם֮ וּלְהַרְבּ֣וֹת אֶתְכֶם֒ כֵּ֣ן יָשִׂ֤ישׂ יְהוָה֙ עֲלֵיכֶ֔ם לְהַאֲבִ֥יד אֶתְכֶ֖ם וּלְהַשְׁמִ֣יד אֶתְכֶ֑ם וְנִסַּחְתֶּם֙ מֵעַ֣ל הָֽאֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־ אַתָּ֥ה בָא־ שָׁ֖מָּה לְרִשְׁתָּֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh ka·’ă·šer- śāś Yah·weh ‘ă·lê·ḵem lə·hê·ṭîḇ ’eṯ·ḵem ū·lə·har·bō·wṯ ’eṯ·ḵem kên yā·śîś Yah·weh ‘ă·lê·ḵem lə·ha·’ă·ḇîḏ ’eṯ·ḵem ū·lə·haš·mîḏ ’eṯ·ḵem wə·nis·saḥ·tem mê·‘al hā·’ă·ḏā·māh ’ă·šer- ’at·tāh ḇā- šām·māh lə·riš·tāh
verses.literal: Just as it pleased the LORD to make you prosper and multiply so also it will please Him . . . to annihilate you and destroy you And you will be uprooted from the land you are entering . . . to possess
verses.literalPt: E será que, assim como o SENHOR se deleitava em vós, em fazer-vos bem e multiplicar-vos, assim o SENHOR se deleitará em destruir-vos e consumir-vos; e desarraigados sereis da terra a qual passais a possuir.

verses.original: וֶהֱפִֽיצְךָ֤ יְהוָה֙ בְּכָל־ הָ֣עַמִּ֔ים מִקְצֵ֥ה הָאָ֖רֶץ וְעַד־ קְצֵ֣ה הָאָ֑רֶץ וְעָבַ֨דְתָּ שָּׁ֜ם אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֧ר לֹא־ יָדַ֛עְתָּ אַתָּ֥ה וַאֲבֹתֶ֖יךָ עֵ֥ץ וָאָֽבֶן׃
verses.transliteration: we·hĕ·p̄î·ṣə·ḵā Yah·weh bə·ḵāl hā·‘am·mîm miq·ṣêh hā·’ā·reṣ wə·‘aḏ- qə·ṣêh hā·’ā·reṣ wə·‘ā·ḇaḏ·tā šām ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’ă·ḥê·rîm ’ă·šer lō- yā·ḏa‘·tā ’at·tāh wa·’ă·ḇō·ṯe·ḵā ‘êṣ wā·’ā·ḇen
verses.literal: Then the LORD will scatter you among all the nations from one end of the earth to the other . . . and there you will worship other gods gods of wood and stone which neither you nor your fathers have known
verses.literalPt: E o SENHOR vos espalhará entre todos os povos, desde uma extremidade da terra até à outra; e ali servireis a outros deuses que não conheceste, nem tu nem teus pais; ao pau e à pedra.

verses.original: וּבַגּוֹיִ֤ם הָהֵם֙ לֹ֣א תַרְגִּ֔יעַ וְלֹא־ יִהְיֶ֥ה מָנ֖וֹחַ לְכַף־ רַגְלֶ֑ךָ וְנָתַן֩ יְהוָ֨ה לְךָ֥ שָׁם֙ לֵ֣ב רַגָּ֔ז וְכִלְי֥וֹן עֵינַ֖יִם וְדַֽאֲב֥וֹן נָֽפֶשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇag·gō·w·yim hā·hêm lō ṯar·gî·a‘ wə·lō- yih·yeh mā·nō·w·aḥ lə·ḵap̄- raḡ·le·ḵā wə·nā·ṯan Yah·weh lə·ḵā šām lêḇ rag·gāz wə·ḵil·yō·wn ‘ê·na·yim wə·ḏa·’ă·ḇō·wn nā·p̄eš
verses.literal: Among those nations you will find no repose not even a resting place for the sole of your foot There the LORD will give you a trembling heart failing eyes and a despairing soul
verses.literalPt: E nem ainda entre estas nações descansarás, nem a planta de teu pé terá repouso; porquanto o SENHOR ali te dará coração agitado, e desfalecimento de olhos, e desmaio da alma.

verses.original: וְהָי֣וּ חַיֶּ֔יךָ תְּלֻאִ֥ים לְךָ֖ מִנֶּ֑גֶד וּפָֽחַדְתָּ֙ לַ֣יְלָה וְיוֹמָ֔ם וְלֹ֥א תַאֲמִ֖ין בְּחַיֶּֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yū ḥay·ye·ḵā tə·lu·’îm lə·ḵā min·ne·ḡeḏ ū·p̄ā·ḥaḏ·tā lay·lāh wə·yō·w·mām wə·lō ṯa·’ă·mîn bə·ḥay·ye·ḵā
verses.literal: So your life will hang in doubt before you and you will be afraid night and day never certain of survival
verses.literalPt: E a tua vida, como em suspenso, estará diante de ti; e estremecerás de noite e de dia, e não crerás na tua própria vida.

verses.original: בַּבֹּ֤קֶר תֹּאמַר֙ מִֽי־ יִתֵּ֣ן עֶ֔רֶב וּבָעֶ֥רֶב תֹּאמַ֖ר מִֽי־ יִתֵּ֣ן בֹּ֑קֶר מִפַּ֤חַד לְבָֽבְךָ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תִּפְחָ֔ד וּמִמַּרְאֵ֥ה עֵינֶ֖יךָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר תִּרְאֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: bab·bō·qer tō·mar mî- yit·tên ‘e·reḇ ū·ḇā·‘e·reḇ tō·mar mî- yit·tên bō·qer mip·pa·ḥaḏ lə·ḇā·ḇə·ḵā ’ă·šer tip̄·ḥāḏ ū·mim·mar·’êh ‘ê·ne·ḵā ’ă·šer tir·’eh
verses.literal: In the morning you will say If only . . . it were evening and in the evening you will say If only . . . it were morning because of the dread in your hearts of the terrifying sights . . . you will see
verses.literalPt: Pela manhã dirás: Ah! quem me dera ver a noite! E à tarde dirás: Ah! quem me dera ver a manhã! pelo pasmo de teu coração, que sentirás, e pelo que verás com os teus olhos.

verses.original: וֶֽהֱשִֽׁיבְךָ֨ יְהוָ֥ה׀ מִצְרַיִם֮ בָּאֳנִיּוֹת֒ בַּדֶּ֙רֶךְ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָמַ֣רְתִּֽי לְךָ֔ לֹא־ תֹסִ֥יף ע֖וֹד לִרְאֹתָ֑הּ וְהִתְמַכַּרְתֶּ֨ם שָׁ֧ם לְאֹיְבֶ֛יךָ לַעֲבָדִ֥ים וְלִשְׁפָח֖וֹת וְאֵ֥ין קֹנֶֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: we·hĕ·šî·ḇə·ḵā Yah·weh miṣ·ra·yim bā·’o·nî·yō·wṯ bad·de·reḵ ’ă·šer ’ā·mar·tî lə·ḵā lō- ṯō·sîp̄ ‘ō·wḏ lir·’ō·ṯāh wə·hiṯ·mak·kar·tem šām lə·’ō·yə·ḇe·ḵā la·‘ă·ḇā·ḏîm wə·liš·p̄ā·ḥō·wṯ wə·’ên qō·neh
verses.literal: The LORD will return you to Egypt in ships by a route that I said you should never see again . . . There you will sell yourselves to your enemies as male and female slaves but no one will buy you
verses.literalPt: E o SENHOR te fará voltar ao Egito em navios, pelo caminho de que te tenho dito; nunca jamais o verás; e ali sereis vendidos como escravos e escravas aos vossos inimigos; mas não haverá quem vos compre.
